paragraphs: Elazar ben Mahavai (a Tanna), [Shabbat 110b (106b in the linked edition)](https://www.sefaria.org/Shabbat.106b.9).[^1][^2]

notes.text: Hyman cites Shabbat 110b here. The named baraita is on 106b in the linked edition, which [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=557&lang=en) also cites.
The linked text gives Elazar ben Mahavai without a personal title. Hyman describes him as a tanna.
